basic_profile.bio: A seasoned writer and storyteller residing in Portland, Oregon. I have a deep passion for creative writing, often drawing inspiration from nature and daily life. By day, I work as a freelance editor, helping others carve their narratives. In my free time, I delve into Haruki Murakami's surreal worlds and enjoy discussions around innovative tech. I'm happily married with two cats, and I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holding a degree in English Literature, I've spent over a decade honing my writing skills. My expertise is further enriched by self-study and engaging in community-driven discussions on platforms like Reddit. I embrace lifelong learning, especially around emerging technologies and their impact on storytelling.
